question: Pongal is primarily celebrated in which Indian state?
solution: The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Pongal** is a four-day-long harvest festival celebrated primarily in the Indian state of **Tamil Nadu**. It corresponds to the **Makar Sankranti** festival celebrated under various names throughout India. • The festival is celebrated at the start of the **Tamil month** of **Thai**, which usually falls on **January 14th or 15th** of the **Gregorian calendar**. • It is a festival of **thanksgiving** to nature and the **Sun God (Surya)** for providing the energy for agriculture and a successful **harvest**. • The word "Pongal" in **Tamil** literally means "to boil over" or "overflowing," symbolizing **abundance** and **prosperity**. • While **Tamil Nadu** is the primary location, it is also celebrated in the Union Territory of **Puducherry** and by the **Tamil diaspora** in countries like **Sri Lanka**, **Malaysia**, and **Singapore**.
